notes.title: Almost My Floor Sequel Trailer
notes.content:
[h3]Good news!

We have released a trailer for the sequel of Almost My Floor! [/h3]

The main feature of the game is its variability in gameplay. The heroes can experience the story in different ways, and they might not even survive at all. The game features several main characters, each with their own perspective on events and unique abilities. Whether everyone will stay alive by the end of the game depends on the chosen path of progression.

[previewyoutube=XvGh1Vk4x90;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Devlog 11
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone! Preparations for the release are in full swing, fixing (hopefully) the latest bugs.

Not many people know, but the project has greatly mutated during the development process, new mechanics have grown and it has become bigger. Initially, it was a horror story without a story about a guy who just ends up on different floors. After the Potata game release, we wanted to make a small project. But maybe another time =) Now it's a whole story with several characters, twists... everything is as it should be. [/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ntk7Vfe.gif[/img]

notes.title: Devlog 09 - changes in exploration system
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone! We didn't about our progress for a long time, and I think the moment has come. We thought a lot about our exploration system and decided to slightly change it.

Previously, when you click on any active object in a location, a selection window always appeared and you had to click on one of the options. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568114/745dcb12be39ad189f5c665c546aea65f8548b8c.png[/img]

If this is an item, then examine it or take it. If a person - then examine or talk. We thought that many items cannot be taken and the hero often just says a standard reply, or something superfluous.
Fun fact - in the early stages there were always 3 options at one time.

And now we've added objects that can only be inspected or only taken and they will have special icons on the cursor. Thus, the player will poke fewer times and examine the location faster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568114/aa4ab16a2040faaa41675dc34c9e9a2e9e468946.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568114/4619cbbf3e1ab355cf45e9a982232f750ef2c028.png[/img]

Don't worry, the option with simultaneous inspection and taking is still there. For items like that cursor now slightly changed, it has a question mark inside.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568114/a38aba081c7372a150aac6e42457a703be3ee3f5.png[/img][/h3]

notes.title: The release date postponed to August 2021
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone! The world of the game is getting bigger compared to the original plans, new heroes, new places and plot twists appear. We have to admit that we need more time to fine-tune the game, so we have to postpone the release of the game until August 2021 in order to give our best, put into the game everything we want, and polish it.

Here are some interesting new locations that weren't on the original plans. [/h3]

notes.title: Devlog 06 - Prologue is coming on 5 October 2020!
notes.content:
[h2]Good news, everyone! The prologue is coming pretty soon (5 October 2020) and we are so excited to hear your feedback![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1395230/Almost_My_Floor_Prologue/

[h3]So what we did last month? Of course, we've spent a lot of time to polish the game in the first locations, where are placed the prologue. And a lot of bugfixes. It was so uncomfortable to see videos on youtube when players meet critical bugs and can't go any further... my god, it was horrible... but worries not, we've fixed everything that was mentioned and the game is ready for mass players =)

Let me show you something to make you more excited about the game =)

The main news, we've made a solution to add comics to our game!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568114/325d347bca46e6086e6a7a46bd08d735b6afba42.png[/img]
Pretty awesome, right?

There are a lot of places when need to make a solution and now you have little helpers: angel and demon. They help you make the right choice and comment on your actions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568114/3d26a9d396a1f00b94a559e6c17c0b3f174ce1d6.png[/img][/h3]
